newsitem.title: USA: Biolase sees sales growth, better margins.
newsitem.headline: Biolase sees sales growth, better margins.

text.p: Biolase Technology Inc said Friday that it expects continued growth in sales and improved margins and returns in the third quarter and beyond.
The company added however that third quarter production activities would also involve some additional ramp-up costs relating to production design and production layout.

Additionally, the company said it is continuing efforts to collect about $96,000 in debt. The company recorded a provision for bad debt in the quarter for that amount to cover what it said was a bank's technical defects in documentation.

It said that looking at the third quarter and forward, it also expects increased sales and production of its Millennium systems and plans to begin making its DermaLase surgical systems and its soon-to-be-released light-amplified LaserBrush.
The company said it plans to begin marketing its DermaLase system domestically and abroad in September 1997.
